name: Premium Marketing Website
description: A visually stunning, high-performance marketing website inspired by Apple's design philosophy—clean, minimalist, and content-first—with strict copyright compliance.

features.name: Create Multi-Stage Dockerfile
features.description: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile with Node.js build stage and Nginx static serve stage.
steps: Create Dockerfile at project root with Node.js 20 Alpine build stage
Add Nginx Alpine stage to serve static export from out/
Verify docker build -t premium-site . completes without errors
Verify built image serves static files on port 80

features.name: Create docker-compose.yml for Development
features.description: Create docker-compose.yml for local development with hot-reload.
steps: Create docker-compose.yml that mounts source code as volume
Configure npm run dev to run inside the container
Expose port 3000 for local access
Verify hot-reload works when source files change

features.name: Create .dockerignore and .env.example
features.description: Create Docker ignore file and environment variable template.
steps: Create .dockerignore excluding node_modules, .next, out, .git
Create .env.example with placeholder variables
Verify Docker build context is optimized

features.name: Initialize Next.js App with TypeScript & Tailwind
features.description: Set up the Next.js application with all core dependencies.
steps: Initialize Next.js with App Router and src/ directory
Configure TypeScript
Install and configure Tailwind CSS
Install framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge
Verify src/app/page.tsx renders and Tailwind classes work

features.name: Configure Tailwind Design Tokens
features.description: Set up the design system tokens in Tailwind config.
steps: Define neutral and accent color palettes in tailwind.config.ts
Configure fontFamily.display and fontFamily.body
Add custom spacing values for hero and section
Enable darkMode: 'class'
Verify token classes work in components

features.name: Set Up next/font with Inter
features.description: Configure self-hosted Inter font for optimal performance.
steps: Import Inter from next/font/google in layout.tsx
Apply font variable to html tag
Reference --font-display in Tailwind config
Verify no FOUT or CLS on page load

features.name: Create ThemeProvider Context
features.description: Build React context for theme management with persistence.
steps: Create ThemeProvider component in src/components/providers/
Read initial theme from localStorage or prefers-color-scheme
Provide theme, setTheme, and toggleTheme via context
Apply .dark class to html element
Verify theme persists across page reloads without flash

features.name: Create Header Component
features.description: Build the global sticky header with navigation and theme toggle.
steps: Create Header component with sticky positioning and backdrop blur
Add logo/brand name on the left
Add navigation links (Products, Support, Contact) on the right
Integrate ThemeToggle button
Implement mobile hamburger menu with slide-out animation
Verify all nav links work and mobile menu opens/closes

features.name: Create Footer Component
features.description: Build the global footer with links and copyright.
steps: Create Footer component with three columns of links
Add copyright notice at bottom
Add placeholder social media icons
Verify footer renders consistently on all pages

features.name: Create Button and ThemeToggle Components
features.description: Build reusable Button and ThemeToggle UI components.
steps: Create Button component with primary, secondary, ghost variants
Create ThemeToggle component with Sun/Moon icons from Lucide
Connect ThemeToggle to toggleTheme context function
Verify both components are keyboard accessible

features.name: Wire Up Root Layout
features.description: Connect all layout components in the root layout file.
steps: Wrap children in ThemeProvider in layout.tsx
Render Header above main content
Render Footer below main content
Set global metadata (title, description)
Verify Header and Footer appear on all pages

features.name: Implement Dark Mode CSS Variables
features.description: Define CSS custom properties for light and dark themes.
steps: Define :root CSS variables for light mode in globals.css
Define .dark CSS variables for dark mode
Update Tailwind config to use CSS variables
Verify all colors update when theme toggles

features.name: Create Hero Component
features.description: Build the full-screen hero section with animation.
steps: Create Hero component with min-h-screen layout
Add centered headline, tagline, and CTA button
Add background image with overlay
Implement fade-in animation on load
Verify text is readable over image on all screen sizes

features.name: Create ProductHighlight Component
features.description: Build the alternating product highlight section.
steps: Create ProductHighlight with image and text layout
Add reverse prop to flip layout direction
Add Learn More link to product detail page
Make layout responsive (stack on mobile)
Verify alternating layout works correctly

features.name: Create AnimatedSection Wrapper
features.description: Build Framer Motion wrapper for scroll-triggered animations.
steps: Create AnimatedSection component using Framer Motion
Implement fade-in and slide-up on viewport entry
Add prefers-reduced-motion support to disable animations
Verify animations trigger when scrolling

features.name: Create Product Data File
features.description: Create structured product data for the site.
steps: Create Product TypeScript interface in src/types/product.ts
Create src/data/products.ts with at least 2 sample products
Include id, slug, name, tagline, description, features, specs, images
Verify data imports correctly in components

features.name: Build Home Page
features.description: Assemble the complete Home page with all sections.
steps: Build src/app/page.tsx with Hero section
Add 2+ ProductHighlight sections mapped from product data
Wrap sections in AnimatedSection for scroll animations
Verify Learn More links navigate to product pages

features.name: Create FeatureGrid Component
features.description: Build the responsive feature grid with icons.
steps: Create FeatureGrid component with icon, title, description cards
Make grid responsive (2 cols mobile, 3-4 cols desktop)
Use Lucide icons with accessible aria-labels
Wrap in AnimatedSection for scroll animation

features.name: Create SpecsTable Component
features.description: Build the two-column technical specifications table.
steps: Create SpecsTable component with key-value layout
Add zebra striping for readability
Use semantic table HTML with proper headers
Verify dark mode styling works

features.name: Create ComparisonTable Component
features.description: Build the multi-column product comparison table.
steps: Create ComparisonTable with row headers and product columns
Highlight current product column
Make table horizontally scrollable on mobile
Verify accessibility with screen reader

features.name: Build Product Detail Page
features.description: Create the dynamic product detail page template.
steps: Create src/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx
Fetch product data by slug parameter
Render product Hero, FeatureGrid, SpecsTable, ComparisonTable
Add page-specific metadata for SEO
Verify correct data renders for each product URL

features.name: Implement generateStaticParams
features.description: Enable static generation for all product pages.
steps: Export generateStaticParams from product page
Return all product slugs for static generation
Run npm run build and verify pages are pre-rendered
Verify build output shows all product paths

features.name: Create Custom 404 Page
features.description: Build a branded 404 error page.
steps: Create src/app/not-found.tsx with branded design
Add helpful message and link to Home
Verify invalid routes show the custom 404 page

features.name: Create FAQ Data File
features.description: Create structured FAQ data for the support page.
steps: Create FAQ TypeScript interface in src/types/faq.ts
Create src/data/faqs.ts with 5-10 sample FAQ entries
Verify data imports correctly

features.name: Create FAQAccordion Component
features.description: Build the accessible accordion component for FAQs.
steps: Create FAQAccordion component with expand/collapse functionality
Add animated open/close transitions
Implement aria-expanded and keyboard navigation
Verify accordion is fully accessible

features.name: Build Support Page
features.description: Create the Support/FAQ page.
steps: Create src/app/support/page.tsx with heading and intro
Render FAQAccordion with data from faqs.ts
Add link to Contact page
Verify accordion is functional

features.name: Build Contact Page
features.description: Create the Contact page with form.
steps: Create src/app/contact/page.tsx with contact information
Add form with Name, Email, Message fields
Implement client-side validation (required, email format)
Verify form is accessible and validation works

features.name: Performance, Accessibility & E2E Testing
features.description: Final polish, optimization, and testing.
steps: Optimize all images (WebP, sizing, blur placeholders)
Add SEO metadata (title, description, OG tags) to all pages
Run Lighthouse audit and fix issues until score > 90
Run axe-core accessibility audit and fix violations
Write Playwright E2E tests for core user journeys
Finalize Docker production build and verify static export
Verify all tests pass
